author: wecr
body:
Well as much as I love many mini-games on this server, sometimes an auto-balance is necessary to keep the games fun and fair

Here is good enough reasoning - http://tinypic.com/r/1yooao/8
Here is another one since that picture above dosn't show its justice - http://tinypic.com/r/nn8745/8

Yes that's right it was a 5 v 2 v 2 v 2 Nobody but pink/red could even get close to the middle

Eventually the games ended up being a total wipe-out with red team winning in two rounds, and nobody else getting ANY points (exception on the second picture where I hardly managed to get 10 measly points for my team), this compleatly ruined the game-play and they kept doing this for 5 ROUNDS!
After that I juts got tired of the BS and left the game

replies.author: Mooch24
replies.body:
Eh, auto-balance can get annoying.

Donors could just leave and rejoin if the timer between the forced balance is a long interval. If it's rather quick, players will be constantly jumbled around and those who didn't stack in the first place will be constantly moved and it can get extremely aggravating for those who did nothing wrong in the first place.

I personally think it'd be better to see a percentage limit. You physically can't stack a team. Ex: Lets say there is a walls match. It's currently a 3v2v2v2. A donor would like to join his friend on the first team with the most players. The percentage limit, whatever it would be, would block him from joining the team to make sure it's fair.
  
Sorry for the poor explanation. It sounded better in my head :P

replies.body:
Maybe donators can't join a team where it has 2 more people. All players should be able to join a team of their choosing, but can't teamstack.
Think of TF2, all players can choose a team, but they can't choose a team with the most players.
